title: Don't Wait Up
briefing: He said dentist. He said don't wait up. The water is still running.

questions.rationale: Mara is an executive recruiter pitching a new job position to Jonah.
questions.evidenceHint: Review Mara's messages and the compensation note.

questions.prompt: Was Jonah at the dentist on Thursday?
questions.rationale: The dentist appointment was a cover story used to hide a confidential interview.
questions.evidenceHint: Compare the calendar note with Dex's text messages.

questions.rationale: Jonah traveled to Harboridge for an on-site interview.
questions.evidenceHint: Check the hotel photo and location history.

questions.prompt: Why did he go to Harboridge?
questions.rationale: Jonah was interviewing for an unannounced corporate role.
questions.evidenceHint: Examine the visitor badge image and compensation breakdown.

questions.prompt: Did Dex help Jonah hide something from Mina?
questions.rationale: Dex agreed to back up the story while Jonah was out of town.
questions.evidenceHint: Read Dex's thread and ephemeral messages.

questions.prompt: Is the ring Cal mentioned for Mina?
questions.rationale: The ring mentioned by Cal was for Cal's own partner.
questions.evidenceHint: Read the full text in Cal's thread.

questions.rationale: Messages with Cal discuss personal matters but leave job knowledge ambiguous.
questions.evidenceHint: Cal's messages make no reference to the interview.

questions.rationale: They had dinner at a hotel bar, but messages leave personal intentions ambiguous.
questions.evidenceHint: Compare the bar photo with Mara's DMs.

questions.prompt: Does Jonah have a job offer?
questions.rationale: The formal offer note details salary and start date.
questions.evidenceHint: Read the offer note in Notes.

questions.prompt: Has Jonah told Mina any of this?
questions.rationale: Jonah admits in drafts that he hasn't told Mina about the offer.
The relocation would require moving, but Jonah's choice is undecided.
questions.evidenceHint: Drafts show internal conflict without a final call.

questions.prompt: Is he going to take the Harboridge job?
questions.rationale: Jonah has received the offer letter but has not accepted it.
questions.evidenceHint: Check the response deadline on the offer note.

questions.prompt: Is the mom thread about Harboridge?
questions.rationale: The thread with Mom discusses family updates, not the interview.

questions.prompt: Is he still hiding it today?
questions.rationale: Jonah's recent calls and messages show he is still keeping the offer secret.
questions.evidenceHint: Check recent calls and text threads from today.

questions.prompt: Does Mara want more than a placement?
questions.rationale: Mara's social messages mix professional recruitment with friendly warmth.
